title: digest output shape

setup.note: wa:sunrise-apartments-402, the P-06 example week (Mon 2026-08-24). One digest.v2 call over the ended week. The output must be a summary, durable claims with evidence, and recurrences — never a task surfaced as active, never anything marked as needing the user; the 'volunteers needed — reply here' line is a recurrence candidate at most.

input_events: e1 2026-08-25T09:00:00Z secretary: "Water tank cleaning this Thursday 10am-1pm. Please store water in advance."
e2 2026-08-26T18:20:00Z secretary: "Lift B will be under maintenance till Saturday. Use lift A."
e3 2026-08-27T08:30:00Z secretary: "Reminder: maintenance for Sept due by 5th. Pay by UPI to society@okaxis or at the office."
e4 2026-08-28T19:05:00Z secretary: "Ganpati decoration volunteers needed for the 6th — reply here if free."
e5 2026-08-30T10:00:00Z secretary: "Parking: sticker renewal for 2026-27 starts Monday at the office, Rs.500 per car."

expected.understanding: a two-line summary of the week's society notices; a recurrence for the monthly maintenance due by the 5th (rule: monthly on the 5th) with evidence quoting e3; any claim carries verbatim evidence; the volunteers line is NOT a task and nothing is marked as needing the user

wrong.label: active-task
wrong.assert_absent: a task created or surfaced as active/open from a tier-3 digest

wrong.label: digest-inflation
wrong.assert_absent: tasks, episodes, spaces, schedules, closures, questions or follow-ups in the digest result

source.section: GoldenEvals V6P1 §5.18 DIG-02 · digest output shape
